title: FedEx Singapore Ranks #5 Among Singapore’s Best Workplaces in 2026
body_markdown:
**SINGAPORE, November 3, 2026** — Federal Express Corporation (FedEx), one of the world’s largest express transportation companies, has been ranked[#5 among Singapore’s Best Workplaces ® 2026 for large organisations by Great Place to Work®,](https://greatplacetowork.com.sg/best-workplaces/singapore/)


recognizing the company’s strong workplace culture, employee experience and ongoing commitment to making FedEx one of the best employers in Singapore.


According to Great Place to Work®, 87% of FedEx Singapore employees say the company is a great place to work, compared with 49% of employees at a typical company in Singapore. The recognition is based on the Trust Index™ Survey, which measures employee feedback and workplace experiences across key dimensions including trust, pride, respect and comradery.


The recognition reflects FedEx Singapore’s continued investment in its people through well-being programs,career development and leadership opportunities, and a workplace culture built on the company’s long-standing People-Service-Profit (PSP) philosophy. By investing in our people first, FedEx empowers team members to grow, collaborate, innovate and deliver exceptional service for customers across Singapore and around the world.


“Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and this Top 5 ranking is a reflection of the culture our team members help create every day,” said Salil Chari, Regional President of FedEx Asia Pacific.” At FedEx, we are committed to fostering an environment where team members feel valued, supported and empowered to build meaningful careers. This recognition reinforces the strength of our People-Service-Profit philosophy and our belief that when we invest in our people, we create better outcomes for our customers, communities and business.”


FedEx Singapore’s people-first approach has been recognized by other leading employer benchmarks. In 2026,[FedEx Singapore received the Silver Ribbon Mental Health Award for the sixth consecutive year.](https://www.silverribbonsingapore.com/mhworkplace/silver-ribbon-mental-health-awards-ceremony-for-employers/)


In 2025, the company was named one of **HR Asia’s *Best Companies to Work for in Asia (Singapore*** *)* for the third consecutive year and received the ***HR Asia Most Caring Company Award 2025.*** These accolades ****** highlight the company’s commitment to creating an inclusive, caring and high-performing workplace where team members can thrive.
